name: Hornero Volume
description: Audio Extensions 2.0: compact bar indicator, details popover and dashboard card for output volume over the shared PluginKit Audio facade, with honest muted and no-output-device states.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Audio Extensions 2.0: compact indicator with host-owned popover (volume slider, step and mute controls), dashboard card, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog, over the shared PluginKit Audio facade only.
Bar widget showing output volume with inline mute, decrease and increase buttons.

showPercentage.description: Show the output volume percentage next to the bar indicator.

showWhenNoSink.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as no output device, when no sink is present.
